name: Premier League
blurb: The most-watched league on the planet — 20 clubs, 38 rounds, three go down.

name: La Liga
blurb: Spain's top flight, home of El Clásico and a technical, possession-first style.

name: Serie A
blurb: Tactical chess in Italy's top division, from San Siro to the Stadio Maradona.

name: Bundesliga
blurb: 18 clubs, packed terraces and the highest average attendance in world football.

name: Ligue 1
blurb: France's elite division and Europe's leading talent factory.

name: UEFA Champions League
blurb: Europe's elite club competition — a 36-team league phase into the knockouts.

name: UEFA Europa League
blurb: UEFA's second-tier club competition, with a Champions League spot for the winner.

name: EFL Championship
blurb: England's relentless second tier: 24 clubs, 46 games and the richest play-off in football.

name: Eredivisie
blurb: Total football's home, built on attacking play and youth development.

name: Primeira Liga
blurb: Portugal's top flight, dominated by Benfica, Porto and Sporting CP.

name: Süper Lig
blurb: Some of Europe's loudest stadiums and the fierce Istanbul derbies.

name: Scottish Premiership
blurb: 12 clubs, a split after 33 games and the Old Firm rivalry at its heart.

name: Belgian Pro League
blurb: Belgium's top flight, with a championship play-off to settle the title.

name: Saudi Pro League
blurb: Big-name signings and fast-rising ambitions in the Gulf.

name: MLS
blurb: Two conferences, 30 clubs and the MLS Cup Playoffs to crown a champion.

name: Liga MX
blurb: Apertura and Clausura tournaments, each settled by the Liguilla play-offs.

name: Brasileirão
blurb: Brazil's 20-team Série A — flair, pressure and huge crowds.

name: Liga Profesional
blurb: Argentina's top flight, home of the Superclásico between Boca and River.
